title: SC grants one week to petitioner to file rejoinder in Jantar Mantar protest site case

ai.summary: The Supreme Court granted a week for a petitioner to file a rejoinder challenging Delhi Police's de-notification of Jantar Mantar as a protest site, shifting demonstrations to three alternative locations in Delhi.

facts.claim: The Supreme Court granted a week for a petitioner to file a rejoinder in her plea challenging Delhi Police's decision to de-notify Jantar Mantar as a designated protest site and shift demonstrations to three alternative locations in the national capital.
facts.quote: SC grants one week to petitioner to file rejoinder in Jantar Mantar protest site case

facts.claim: On October 15, a bench comprising Chief Justice Surya Kant and justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana had sought responses of the Centre and Delhi Police on the petition filed by Swaty Singh challenging the October 11 order de-notifying Jantar Mantar as designated protest site.
facts.quote: On October 15, a bench comprising Chief Justice Surya Kant and justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana had sought responses of the Centre and Delhi Police on the petition filed by Swaty Singh challenging the October 11 order de-notifying Jantar Mantar as designated protest site.

facts.claim: Delhi Police Commissioner Anurag Kumar's standing order dated October 11 de-notified Jantar Mantar and designated the Ramlila Ground, Burari Ground and the CBD Ground in east Delhi as the new venues for protests and demonstrations.
facts.quote: Delhi Police Commissioner Anurag Kumar's standing order dated October 11 de-notified Jantar Mantar and designated the Ramlila Ground, Burari Ground and the CBD Ground in east Delhi as the new venues for protests and demonstrations.

facts.claim: The plea said that shifting protests to distant and outlying areas could render the fundamental rights to peaceful assembly and freedom of expression ineffective.
facts.quote: The plea said that shifting protests to distant and outlying areas could render the fundamental rights to peaceful assembly and freedom of expression ineffective.

facts.claim: The location of a protest is, therefore, not an inconsequential administrative consideration.

ai.background_note: The Supreme Court is examining whether Delhi Police's de-notification of Jantar Mantar as a protest site and designation of alternative locations is procedurally sound and effective for protest rights.
